name: FLIGHT MSG-01: Fleet Message Integrity, Truncation Detection & Honest Error Boundaries (#1043 & #1046)

message_integrity_and_truncation_detecti.cryptographic_verification: Deterministic SHA-256 digest computed and stamped across send, broadcast, message.created push seam, inbox, and inbox_lease
message_integrity_and_truncation_detecti.detection: Receivers can verify packet integrity and immediately detect cut or partial instruction deliveries

honest_error_boundaries.visibility_errors: Cross-squad sends to unpermitted targets return exact send_target_not_visible (404), never misreporting as 'session expired'
honest_error_boundaries.inactive_target_guard: Sends to inactive/retired agents return target_agent_inactive (409)
